items.title: Stanford 发布 2026 AI Index
items.summary: 年度报告覆盖模型能力、投资、采用、治理与社会影响，为跨区域比较提供独立数据框架。
items.summaryEn: The annual report tracks model capability, investment, adoption, governance and societal impact with independently compiled data.

items.title: OECD.AI 汇集全球 AI 政策与治理资料
items.titleEn: OECD.AI tracks global AI policy and governance
items.summary: 可用于跟踪各国的 AI 战略、法规、创新生态与可信 AI 政策进展。
items.summaryEn: The policy observatory tracks national strategies, regulation, innovation ecosystems and trustworthy-AI work.

items.title: IEA 氢能追踪器更新项目、基础设施与承购数据
items.titleEn: IEA tracker updates projects, infrastructure and offtake data
items.summary: 项目级数据涵盖低排放氢产能、管道、地下储氢与已签署承购协议。
items.summaryEn: Project-level data covers low-emissions production, pipelines, storage and signed offtake agreements.

items.title: 绿氨作为氢衍生品进入项目与政策追踪
items.titleEn: Green ammonia enters project and policy tracking
items.summary: 关注可再生电力、制氢、合成氨、港口储运与终端承购之间的完整链条。
items.summaryEn: Track the chain from renewable power and hydrogen through synthesis, port logistics and offtake.

items.title: 绿色甲醇应跟踪碳源、氢源与船舶承购
items.titleEn: E-methanol tracking needs carbon, hydrogen and marine-offtake data
items.summary: 项目判断不只看名义产能，还应核对二氧化碳来源、绿氢成本、认证与长期承购。
items.summaryEn: Project assessment should verify CO₂ source, green-hydrogen cost, certification and long-term offtake.

items.title: SAF 更新应同时关注原料路线与航空需求
items.titleEn: SAF updates should connect pathways with aviation demand
items.summary: 持续跟踪 HEFA、酒精制航煤、气化和电合成路线，以及航空公司承购与政策激励。
items.summaryEn: Track HEFA, alcohol-to-jet, gasification and e-fuel pathways alongside airline offtake and policy support.

items.title: IEA 强调沼气与生物甲烷的能源和减排协同
items.titleEn: IEA highlights the energy and emissions value of biogases
items.summary: 沼气可用于供热和发电；升级后的生物甲烷可替代天然气，并与废弃物和甲烷减排政策相连。
items.summaryEn: Biogas supports heat and power; upgraded biomethane can substitute for gas and links waste management with methane reduction.

items.title: 以全球基准而非单一市场组织观察
items.titleEn: Organize market observation around global benchmarks
items.summary: 用 MSCI ACWI/World、S&P 500、STOXX Europe 600、日经和中国主要指数建立多市场快照。
items.summaryEn: Use MSCI ACWI/World, S&P 500, STOXX Europe 600, Nikkei and major China indices for a multi-market snapshot.

items.title: 世界银行仪表板汇总全球碳定价制度
items.titleEn: World Bank dashboard maps global carbon pricing
items.summary: 该仪表板覆盖碳税、排放交易体系与抵消机制，可按司法辖区查看价格、覆盖范围和制度状态。
items.summaryEn: The dashboard covers taxes, emissions trading and crediting, with jurisdiction-level price, coverage and status data.

items.title: 以世界遗产与地方官方信息建立风景档案
items.titleEn: Build scenery archives from World Heritage and official local sources
items.summary: 文化景观的记录同时连接自然地貌、历史文化、保护规则和可持续旅行信息。
items.summaryEn: Cultural-landscape records connect natural features, history, protection rules and sustainable-travel context.
